profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Indeed.com
profile.summary: Software Engineer passionate about web development and UI analytics

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on the Advertising Experience Team developing the new campaign review page for the campaign creator app in ads.twitter.com using Javascript, ReactJS with Flow and Redux for the frontend and Scala for the backend.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed a micro notification service for the new Dynamics 365 admin panel which will help reduce the emails sent with outdated information about the different services within dynamics to system administrators using technologies such as​ React​ and​ TypeScript ​with Redux ​for the frontend and ​C# ​for the backend

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with the Data Team developing a tool for analyzing Web page contents and classifying the URLs into category tags with a search functionality so a user can have all their information organized using Javascript, ReactJS and Python

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description: Developed a Deployment Status Dashboard for Dynamics 365 CRM in order to have a graphical visualization of all the information and organization of the deployments that the CRM platform has around the different data centers all around the world using technologies of C#, AngularJS, NodeJS, HTML5 and CSS3

positions.title: CodeU Program, Participant
positions.description:
- Worked with small global team building a completed software project by analyzing a base code created by Google and adding functionality over 12 weeks
- Developed a Java based messaging program that required the creation of secure and reliable connections between clients via sockets and threads
- Attend to Youtube Live sessions, realized mocking interviews and had an advisor meetings throughout the whole project

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented AngularJS module for plugin installation to web solution using Javascript, HTML5, CSS3
- Worked with clients collecting necessary information and analyzing their needs for a better implementation of the products
- Developed front end software for tracking vehicles with GPS devices

positions.title: Web & Mobile Developer
positions.description:
- Implemented Android and IOS app to create reports of malfunctions in the public areas of the city of Guadalajara using Java with Android Studio and Swift using XCode.
- Developed web-apps using AngularJS, PHP, Javascript, CSS3, HTML5 and MySQL.

educations.degreeName: Postgraduate Diploma focused in Object Oriented Programming with Java
